from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, json, re, time, hashlib, plistlib, sys
root=Path('/tmp/rustra-ios-audit-20260922')
app=root/'derived-data/Build/Products/Release-iphonesimulator/reactnativecalculator.app'
udid='99B087B5-DEF6-4CF1-9177-81A5DE564CFC'; bundle='dev.rustra.audit20260922'
info=plistlib.loads((app/'Info.plist').read_bytes()); assert info['CFBundleIdentifier']==bundle
def run(*args):
    p=subprocess.run(['xcrun','simctl',*args],text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=60)
    if p.returncode:raise RuntimeError(f'{args[:3]} exited {p.returncode}: {p.stderr[-1500:]}')
    return p.stdout
run('install',udid,str(app))
record={'schemaVersion':1,'simulator':udid,'bundleId':bundle,'artifact':str(app),
        'executableSha256':hashlib.sha256((app/info['CFBundleExecutable']).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        'bundleSha256':hashlib.sha256((app/'main.jsbundle').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'runs':[],'ok':False}
output=root/'simulator-result.json'
try:
    for index in range(5):
        started=time.time(); start_epoch=int(started)
        launch=run('launch','--terminate-running-process',udid,bundle)
        pid=int(launch.strip().rsplit(':',1)[1]); rows=[]; chunks={}; log=''
        while time.time()-started<45:
            log=run('spawn',udid,'log','show','--style','compact','--info','--debug','--start',f'@{start_epoch}',
                '--predicate',f'processIdentifier == {pid} AND eventMessage CONTAINS "RUSTRA_IOS_EVENT_"')
            rows=[]; chunks={}
            for line in log.splitlines():
                for marker in ['RUSTRA_IOS_EVENT_AUDIT=','RUSTRA_IOS_EVENT_SAMPLES=']:
                    if marker not in line:continue
                    payload=line.split(marker,1)[1].strip()
                    try:value=json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(payload)[0]
                    except json.JSONDecodeError:continue
                    if marker.endswith('AUDIT='):rows.append(value)
                    else:chunks[value['index']]=value['samples']
            if any(x.get('phase') in ['complete','failure'] for x in rows):break
            time.sleep(1)
        log_path=root/f'simulator-run-{index+1}.log';log_path.write_text(log)
        result=next((x for x in rows if x.get('phase')=='complete'),None)
        samples=[value for key in sorted(chunks) for value in chunks[key]]
        item={'index':index+1,'pid':pid,'startedAtEpoch':started,'elapsedSeconds':round(time.time()-started,3),
              'observations':rows,'samplesMicroseconds':samples,'log':str(log_path),
              'logSha256':hashlib.sha256(log_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'ok':bool(result and result.get('ok') and len(samples)==1000)}
        record['runs'].append(item);output.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
        print(json.dumps({'run':index+1,'pid':pid,'ok':item['ok'],'last':rows[-1:] ,'samples':len(samples)}),flush=True)
        if not item['ok']:raise RuntimeError('Simulator runtime gate failed; inspect preserved log')
        expected={'pushEvents':[1,2,3],'unsubscribeAdditional':0,'resubscribeEvents':1,'subscriptionCycles':100,'channelMessages':3,'binaryChannelMessages':3,'finalRustCall':3}
        assert all(result.get(k)==v for k,v in expected.items()),result
        ordered=sorted(samples);assert ordered[949]==result['benchmark']['p95']
        run('terminate',udid,bundle)
    record['ok']=True
finally:
    output.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
sys.exit(0 if record['ok'] else 1)
